title: Book Now

hero.alt: Clinical Pilates studio at Together Wellness

seoDescription: Book physiotherapy, clinical Pilates or reformer classes at Together Wellness, Mosman Park.

blocks.title: Book Now
blocks.quote: Whole of body. Whole of life.
blocks.intro: Choose how you would like to start. If you are new to physiotherapy or clinical Pilates with us, begin with an initial consultation so we can understand what is going on and plan from there.

items.caption: Physiotherapy
items.description: Musculoskeletal, pelvic health, pregnancy and postnatal, and sport.
items.body: A 60-minute initial consultation, followed by 30 to 45-minute follow-up appointments. Private health rebates are available.

items.caption: Clinical Pilates
items.description: Up to four people with one physiotherapist.
items.body: 60-minute sessions. An initial physiotherapy assessment is needed before your first session, so we can set your program. Private health rebates are available.

items.caption: Reformer Classes
items.description: Group Reformer, Strength, and Ante and Postnatal classes.
items.body: 60-minute classes for up to 12 people, taught by instructors trained in our physiotherapist-led program.

blocks.heading: Not sure where to start?
blocks.body: Call or email the studio and we will help you choose.
